subject: [hw] DONE V16
body:
V16 (T32 32-bit load/store, exclusive, table branch, branches, system) is implemented and host-tested.  Nothing was run on the phone; nothing published.

Last lines of bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v16/run_tests.sh:
    V16 checks 3284917
    N2TEST V16 PASS 3284917/3284917
    V16 checks 3284917
    N2TEST V16 PASS 3284917/3284917
(the runner prints the verdict twice: ASan+UBSan -O1 build/run, then plain -O2; ~6 s, builds in /tmp/n2hw-v16/build.)

What is implemented (emu/n2a32_t32_mem.c, emu/n2a32_t32_misc.c; full table in emu/test_v16/STATUS.md):
- LDR/STR/LDRB/STRB/LDRH/STRH/LDRSB/LDRSH: imm12, imm8 with negative/positive pre- and post-index and writeback, the eight unprivileged LDRT/STRT/LDRBT/STRBT/LDRHT/STRHT/LDRSBT/LDRSHT forms, register with LSL 0-3, literal (Align(PC,4), both signs); LDR pc and STR pc.
- LDRD/STRD: offset, pre-index, post-index, literal, any encoded Rt/Rt2 pair (the phone libraries use odd Rt and Rt2 != Rt+1: 4309 of 5223 ldrd/strd words in the three dumps).
- LDM/STM IA and DB with/without writeback, PUSH/POP wide, pc in the list via n2a32_bx.
- LDREX/STREX word (imm8*4), LDREXB/H/D, STREXB/H/D through n2a32_excl_*, CLREX.
- TBB/TBH (Rn or PC base; PC base is c->r[15], NOT Align(PC,4) - review finding F13, fixed with a regression test that fails on the old code).
- PLD/PLDW/PLI all addressing forms (no-ops).
- B.W (25-bit imm), B<c>.W (21-bit imm, all 14 conditions), BL, BLX immediate (ARM state, Align(PC,4), LR = PC|1), MRS/MSR APSR, every 32-bit hint (NOP/YIELD/WFE/WFI/SEV/SEVL/DBG), DMB/DSB/ISB, UDF.W (STOP_UNDEF), MRC p15,0,Rt,c13,c0,3 -> tpidruro.

Two facts found while validating, posted to hw-v02/hw-d01: (1) the B.W vs B<c>.W discriminator is hw2 bit 12, not hw1 bits 9-6 (b.w #0 = f000 b800) - the core routing table comment should say so; (2) the TBB/TBH PC base above.

Tests: 2900+ explicit form checks with ARM-ARM-literal expected values, the full immediate range of all four branch forms from llvm-mc-generated tables, 14 conditions x 8 flag combinations, 200000 random words (half from the class spaces) plus a structured sweep of every second halfword for 44 first halfwords (2.9 M calls) under ASan/UBSan.  Encodings come from llvm-mc -triple=thumbv7a-linux-gnueabi -mattr=+neon,+vfp4,+hwdiv,+hwdiv-arm,+fp-armv8 --show-encoding only; no hand-typed hex.

Not done / open (all in dsh-state/workers/V16/STATUS.md):
- T01 differential harness: kernels written (emu/test_v16/k_v16_mem.c, nine k_v16_* functions) and posted to hw-t01 for installation as tests/emu/kernels/k14_v16_mem.c.  I ran the harness in a /tmp copy with them installed: arm-O0 is 2520/2520, but the thumb configs currently fail for nearly every kernel including other packages (k_v16_switch_wide stops on a 16-bit 0xb320 CBZ = V14; k14_alu mismatches), so V16 cannot be validated differentially yet.  Every V16-class instruction of the built libkernels.so decodes OK.
- No phone run (rules).  No arm64 iOS build check (files are portable C11).
- Deliberately UNDEF: LDM/STM empty list / SP in list / Rn=15; LDRD/STRD with Rt or Rt2 = 15; TBB/TBH Rm=15; exclusive forms with any register 15; byte/halfword store of pc; 0xF9C/0xF9D and ops 6/7/14/15; register-offset Rm=15; every coprocessor word except MRC p15,c13,c0,3; B<c>.W with cond 111x; 16-bit words.  Full list with reasons in emu/test_v16/STATUS.md.
- Not modelled: alignment checks, the unprivileged "translate" bit (no MMU), barriers/WFI/WFE are no-ops.

Files changed (all mine): gpu/hwcodec/emu/n2a32_t32_mem.c, gpu/hwcodec/emu/n2a32_t32_misc.c, gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v16/{run_tests.sh,gen_enc.py,t_v16.c,k_v16_mem.c,STATUS.md}, gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/V16/STATUS.md.  No commit (git history is off-limits for workers).  Staying available for review findings from hw-r1/hw-r2 and for the T01 re-run.
